stop_if: Any write is needed outside allowed_files, including imported/generated content, plans, unrelated source, reports beyond the listed readiness artifacts, assets, infrastructure, or external systems.
Official peer metadata no longer supports the pinned Next.js 16.3.3, React 19.2.8, Fumadocs, and Tailwind combination under strict-peer installation.
Any moderate, high, or critical production advisory appears, or remediation requires overrides, hidden installs, registry replacement, or unrelated dependency churn.

Fumadocs MDX would compile fixture, sibling, Git-imported, or otherwise untrusted documentation; arbitrary imports/exports, unsafe HTML/URLs, runtime fetches, path traversal, or source shadowing are introduced.
The existing Zod 3 content/config contracts require a cross-package major migration, or Fumadocs integration requires excluded infrastructure.
Existing custom fallback rendering, ingestion validation, provenance, static search, raw routes, route parity, truthful content, public pages, or build behavior regresses.
Visual checks require updating existing snapshots to hide a regression.
Browser verification collides with an unrelated server or requires stopping/modifying an unrelated process.
A verification command fails twice for the same in-scope cause, or reports/readiness cannot be refreshed truthfully from local evidence.

evidence: T102 receipt records Next.js 16.3.3, React 19.2.8, zero production advisories, 23 routes, lint, typecheck, browser smoke, and build verification.
